title: Stone
body:
Description

Stone is a stone type node that spawns for a limited time after a visit milestone was hit. It can be obtained by visiting the Classic Biome and mining it.

It contains Oreable.

Trivia

  • It was added to the game as a reward for hitting 2 million visits.
    • It was added back on June 28th for hitting 3 million visits, and was removed on July 3rd.
    • It was added back on July 16th for hitting 4 million visits, and was removed on August 1st, 2023.
    • It was again, added back on January 26th, 2024 for hitting 10 million visits, and removed on February 14th, 2024.
    • It was again added June 4th 2024 for hitting 15M visits still available until June 18th.
    • It was not confirmed if it is limited or not, but it most likely is due to its long removal periods.
    • It was originally only obtainable by either trading with another player or waiting for another visit milestone to be made, but has since become indefinitely obtainable on the dedicated classic area off the shore of Ferwater Island.
    • If hit by lightning it will turn into Electrified Rock and play a dialogue saying "Cheese".
